events.description: Called with a closable tab's id when its close mark is pressed, or Delete is pressed on it on web.
events.name: onClose

events.description: Called with the ids now selected each time the selection changes, in the order the items are in.
events.name: onSelectionChange

props.description: The items, in order. The collection never sorts or filters them: the query that fetched them did.
props.name: items

props.description: The emphasis of the selected tab: `primary` is a raised pill, `secondary` a flat one. Defaults to `primary`.
props.name: variant

props.description: True to show every tab but refuse selecting any of them.
props.name: isDisabled

props.description: The spoken name of the tab list, for example "Order sections"; name it when a page holds more than one.
props.name: label

props.description: True while items load: the collection is busy, and shows its loading state in place of the empty one.
props.name: isLoading

props.description:
What happens to tabs that do not fit the row: `scroll` (the default) scrolls the row; `menu` keeps the tabs that
fit and lists the rest in a "More" menu at the end (the selected tab always stays in the row). Native always scrolls.
props.name: overflow

props.description: The spoken name of what loads, for example "Loading orders"; it is read only while `isLoading` is true.
props.name: loadingLabel

props.description: What the collection shows when `items` is empty and nothing is loading, usually an `EmptyState`.
props.name: emptyState

props.description: The ids of the selected items, for a controlled collection; pair it with `onSelectionChange`.
props.name: selectedKeys

props.description: The ids selected at the start, for an uncontrolled collection.
props.name: defaultSelectedKeys

props.description:
The CSS [className](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Element/className) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the class based on component state.
props.name: className

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that describes the object.
props.name: aria-describedby

props.description:
Identifies the element (or elements) that provide a detailed, extended description for the
object.
props.name: aria-details

props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-label

props.description: Identifies the element (or elements) that labels the current element.
props.name: aria-labelledby

props.description:
The element's unique identifier. See
[MDN](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Global_attributes/id).
props.name: id

props.description: Whether tabs are activated automatically on focus or manually.
props.name: keyboardActivation

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

props.description:
Overrides the default DOM element with a custom render function.
This allows rendering existing components with built-in styles and behaviors
such as router links, animation libraries, and pre-styled components.

Requirements:

- You must render the expected element type (e.g. if `<button>` is expected, you cannot render an
  `<a>`).
- Only a single root DOM element can be rendered (no fragments).
- You must pass through props and ref to the underlying DOM element, merging with your own prop
  as appropriate.
props.name: render

props.description:
A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.
props.name: slot

props.description:
The inline [style](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLElement/style) for the
element. A function may be provided to compute the style based on component state.
props.name: style
